fields.label: Connect Drea HR to Drea Finance
fields.description: Off: Drea HR runs on its own. Nothing is sent to Drea Finance and the Finance parts of Payroll Entry stay hidden.

fields.label: Send Payroll
fields.description: When a Payroll Entry's salary slips are submitted, it goes to Drea Finance: totals per company, division and pay code, and one line per person (name, bank account, amounts, take-home) for the bank transfer lists.

fields.label: Tests Only
fields.description: Every send is a dry run in Drea Finance: checked, never booked. Untick once a test month has been checked.

fields.label: Companies → Legal Entities
fields.description: Which Drea Finance legal entity books each company's payroll.

fields.label: Departments → Divisions
fields.description: Which Drea Finance division each department's payroll cost goes to. The divisions are Drea Finance's own list (Drea Finance > Division).

fields.label: Pay Codes → Drea Finance Accounts
fields.description: One row per Drea Finance pay code, with the accounts it books to. Drea Finance keeps no salary settings of its own: this table is sent with every payroll, and Drea Finance checks each account against its chart. Drea Finance's admin gives the account codes.

fields.label: Salary Components → Pay Codes
fields.description: Which pay code each salary component is booked on (codes from the table above). A cut the company keeps (late penalty, unpaid leave) uses the earning it reduces, usually SALARY. A company contribution left out here is not sent.
